title: On the mixing properties of some preconditioned multiproposal Markov Chain Monte Carlo algorithms
summary: We study two recently discovered "dimension-free" Monte Carlo sampling algorithms, the multiproposal and multiple-try preconditioned Crank-Nicolson methods (mpCN and MTpCN). These methods were designed to address certain non-parametric (i.e. infinite-dimensional) sampling problems, defined relative to a Gaussian reference measure, by combining proposal and acceptance mechanisms that take non-trivial advantage of parallel computing architectures.
